answer_1.quote: Tuning large language models to elicit desired responses and behavior from their extensive knowledge and capabilities is essential in the development of chat agents, such as ChatGPT, LLaMA and, characterized by safety, performance, and controllability.

answer_2.quote: automated evaluations were carried out on models trained via RAHF and various baseline methodologies, focusing on their general capabilities and the quality of generation.

answer_3.quote: AlpacaEval is an automated evaluation benchmark based on LLMs. It employs GPT-4 as an annotator to compare the generated content of models on simple instruction-following tasks against reference answers from text-davinci-003.

answer_4.quote: For the human evaluation, we assigned evaluators the task of comparing two randomly selected responses and providing judgments on their relative performance, categorizing them with three results: win, lose, or tie.
answer_4.guideline: comparing two randomly selected responses and providing judgments on their relative performance
